newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest grain prices little changed in sleepy mkt.
newsitem.headline: Budapest grain prices little changed in sleepy mkt.

text.p: Hungarian grains futures prices were little changed on Monday in modest turnover as the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) awaited guidance from international prices, traders said.
"Current prices seem to be realistic and international prices also seem to have settled," said Istvan Grebats of Termin.
He added that July maize, with a relatively large number of open contracts was the one to watch over the next days as players would probably start to close positions.
"I think there are a lot of speculative positions," he said, adding that probably half of the 4,227 contracts would be delivered.
"This might significantly move prices even though there are plenty of stocks," he said.
July maize accounted for 150 contracts of the total 436 contracts or 192.6 million forints turnover, significantly below Friday's 1,914 lots or 672.6 million forints total turnover.
